subject: ClarityHealth PoC: confirmation of success criteria, data needs, and SDK plan
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@clarityhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 14 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: ClarityHealth PoC: kickoff recap + proposed milestones

Hi Sophie — great to meet today. Thanks for walking us through the workflows and priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same view.

Pain points (what you told us)
- Current inference is inconsistent under burst loads; 95th pct latency spikes impact UX for triage flows.
- Cost of large-model calls is a gating factor for production rollout for certain clinician-facing endpoints.
- Data residency and auditability: patient-facing logs must remain in US-only regions and be discoverable for audits.

Current stack
- Backend: Java microservices on AWS EKS behind API Gateway
- Model calls: currently using an in-house transformer for scoring + some OpenAI endpoints for experimental features
- Auth: internal OAuth 2.0 with service-account API keys for back-end jobs

Success criteria for PoC (what success looks like)
- Latency: 95th percentile < 300ms for short prompt/response paths under 50 RPS
- Cost: demonstrable ~20–30% reduction in per-token spend vs current baseline with equivalent output quality
- Compliance: evidence of SOC 2 controls and US-region data residency for PoC traffic
- Integration: Java-based service calls using a Redwood SDK (or REST) with minimal changes to existing auth flow

Proposed PoC outline (4 weeks)
- Week 0 (this week): finalize scope, sign PoC agreement, exchange test datasets and credentials. Owners: Avery (Redwood), Sophie (Clarity)
- Week 1: environment setup, network & auth validation, basic smoke tests (small sample prompts) — Owner: Ben
- Week 2: integration of a Java SDK path + streaming validation; run load tests — Owner: Marissa
- Week 3: quality evaluation vs baseline prompts, cost telemetry collection — Owners: Sophie + Avery
- Week 4: results review, handoff plan and recommended config for production (batching, quantization suggestions)

Open items / asks for Clarity
- Confirm legal point of contact for the PoC (SOC2 & DPA items) and a billing contact.
- Share 3–5 example prompt/response pairs and an anonymized test dataset (S3 link is fine).
- Confirm whether Java SDK is preferred for the PoC or if a thin REST integration is easier.

Attachments: POC_scope_v1.pdf (scope + milestones), sample_auth_flow.png (auth diagram)

Next meeting: I proposed Thu, Feb 18 at 10:00 AM PT for a 30-minute sync to finalize scope — does that work?

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

—
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery@redwood.com

From: Sophie Martin <sophie@clarityhealth.com>

Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClarityHealth PoC: kickoff recap + proposed milestones

Thanks, Avery — helpful recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Data residency & compliance: Clarity requires PoC traffic and any logs derived from production-like prompts to remain in US-only regions. Our legal team (cc'd: James Klein) will need SOC 2 documentation and a draft DPA before we start any data exchange.

2) SDK preference: For speed of integration our backend owners prefer a Java SDK first; if Redwood has a stable Java client we can prioritize that. Otherwise a simple REST path works as a fallback.

3) Billing & cost guardrails: during the PoC we need a cost cap and an alerting mechanism so we don't exceed budget during load tests. Can you share a rough estimate for the 4-week PoC (ballpark range is fine)?

4) Contacts: I'll be the technical POC (Sophie). Legal: James Klein (james.klein@clarityhealth.com). Ops: Mark Patterson will help with infra onboarding.

Confirming Thu, Feb 18 at 10am PT is good for us.

Best,
Sophie
Director, Platform Engineering — ClarityHealth
sophie@clarityhealth.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie@clarityhealth.com>, Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ClarityHealth PoC: kickoff recap + proposed milestones

Hi Sophie — quick technical notes that should help with planning.

- SDKs & timelines: We have stable Python and Node SDKs. Java client is in beta; we can provide a Java beta SDK and integration examples within ~2 weeks. If you want production-grade Java support we should scope that as a follow-on.

- API details: Redwood supports both streaming and non-streaming generation. For short prompt/response paths we can keep tokenization low-cost by using prefix caching and controlled batching.

- Auth: standard API key works for server-to-server flows; we also support ephemeral keys (short-lived tokens) that integrate with your OAuth flow if you want tighter per-request tracing.

- Limits & telemetry: default token limit per request is 128k tokens (configurable); we'll instrument per-route latency, token counts, and cost-per-token in the PoC telemetry dashboard.

- Test dataset: please upload an anonymized S3 link or drop into the Drive folder I created: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-clarity-poc (permission: redwood-sales@redwood.com). Example filename format: clarity_poc_prompts_v1.jsonl

Attaching the current SDK compatibility matrix: redwood-sdk-matrix.xlsx (shows supported languages, streaming, and feature parity).

Let us know if you need a temporary sandbox account with US-only routing — we can provision that once legal sign-off is in place.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Great — thanks for the quick replies and for looping James. A few final confirmations before the Thu sync: 

- Java SDK: we'll deliver the Java beta package and integration examples within 10 business days. That should let your engineers validate the end-to-end call shape and streaming expectations during Week 2.
- SOC 2 & DPA: SOC 2 report and a draft DPA are available here: https://redwood.com/soc2-report — I'll have our legal team send the DPA to James today.
- US-only routing: we will provision a sandbox with US-region routing for the PoC (no logs replicated outside US).
- Cost estimate: for a standard 4-week PoC covering smoke + load tests we typically see ranges tied to token volumes — we'll provide a conservative estimate and a hard cap option before we start any load testing.

Action items (owners)
- Redwood: send DPA to James (Avery)
- Clarity: upload anonymized test prompts to the Drive link and confirm billing contact (Sophie)
- Redwood: Java beta SDK bundle + integration examples (Marissa)
- Both: calendar invite accepted for Thu Feb 18 10:00 AM PT — see HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/CLAR-2026-19

Looking forward to the sync. If anything else pops up before Thu, reply here and we'll triage.
